psychological_meaning: Casper, a muted, cool-toned blue-gray, evokes a sense of tranquility, calmness, and sophistication. It suggests stability and reliability, while also hinting at a touch of mystery and introspection. Its understated nature makes it a versatile choice for creating a balanced and harmonious atmosphere.
